criteria.criterion: Package internal/state loads the plan under the repo root and validates it against the embedded state/v1 schema; the schema decides validity.
criteria.evidence: state.Load/Validate in internal/state/state.go; Validate calls schema.Validate("state/v1"); cli uses g.root()

criteria.criterion: Missing plan is `vloop: no plan: .vloop/state/state.json`, exit 1, nothing on stdout; with --json one JSON document.
criteria.evidence: ErrNoPlan + loadPlan; verify gate checks stderr/exit/JSON; TestStatusMissingPlan

criteria.criterion: A plan failing its schema but parsing is still readable; status exits 0.
criteria.evidence: Load only unmarshals; TestStatusSchemaInvalidPlanStillReads and gate step

criteria.criterion: Atomic save, byte-stable format, literal <>&, updated set to RFC 3339 UTC.
criteria.evidence: Save uses CreateTemp in plan dir + Rename; Marshal SetEscapeHTML(false), indent 2; TestRoundTripByteForByte, TestSaveSetsUpdatedAndLeavesNoTempFile

criteria.criterion: status text format with aligned columns, attempts suffix, -/<kind>, no trailing spaces.
criteria.evidence: writeTaskLines in status.go; gate compares exact output

criteria.criterion: status --json shape and key order; area null when absent.
criteria.evidence: struct field order in status.go, *string Area; gate jq checks

criteria.criterion: status --markdown prints render-plan.sh content to stdout, no file.
criteria.evidence: Plan.Markdown mirrors render-plan.sh; gate line checks; file count unchanged

criteria.criterion: status never modifies the plan or writes any file.
criteria.evidence: only Load used; gate cmp and file count checks

criteria.criterion: Committed tests: state round-trip and no-temp-file; TestStatus* for text, json, markdown, missing plan.
No product code or test touches this repo's .loop/ or .claude/ or home; tests use t.TempDir().
criteria.evidence: grep of internal/state and status*.go shows no such paths; scratch() uses t.TempDir()

criteria.criterion: gofmt, go vet, go mod tidy -diff clean; builds for linux, windows, host.

notes: TestReadmeMatchesCommandTree fails (README lacks schema list/validate/show, status, --markdown); the gate skips it, and the schema failures predate this task. README is a later task. Save drops keys unknown to the structs; the brief left this open.
